'''''Studies in Logic, Grammar and Rhetoric''''' is a journal of [[philosophy]], publishing articles of diverse streams in English.<ref name="slgr">{{Cite web|url=https://www.uwb.edu.pl/studies-in-logic-grammar-and-rhetoric|title= Studies in Logic. Grammar and Rhetoric |access-date=2020-08-22}}</ref>

The journal is abstracted and indexed by [[DOAJ]],<ref>{{cite web|url=https://doaj.org/toc/2199-6059|title=leOAJ}}</ref> [[ERIH PLUS]], [[SCOPUS]], CEJSH (The Central European Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities) e [[Index Copernicus]].<ref name="Sciendo">{{cite web|url=https://sciendo.com/journal/SLGR|title=Studies in Logic, Grammar and Rhetoric. The Journal of University of Bialystok}}</ref>

As of 2024, it has registered a [[H-index]] of 17.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.scimagojr.com/journalsearch.php?q=21100205925&tip=sid|title=Studies in Logic, Grammar and Rhetoric|website=[[SCImago Journal Rank|scimagojr.com]]}}</ref>
